end.summary:
Navya discussed the story’s monkeys and the cap-seller.
They identified that the monkeys took the caps while the cap-seller slept under a tree.
They first mentioned snakes, then corrected this to monkeys in the same turn.
Teach-back was not completed; the lesson ended when Navya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Navya practised recalling story events by looking at the picture and retelling what happened in sequence. They corrected the mix-up between snakes and monkeys while retelling. At home, ask Navya to say or draw three story steps: cap-seller rests, monkeys take the caps, and the cap-seller wakes up.
